methodology.vfs: Production Python BadgeVFS via PythonVFSCore C ABI adapter. Temporary POSIX files.
methodology.equivalence: All three scenarios use byte-for-byte identical compact service-produced operations, checksums and grouping. Both raw variants retain the account local-only JSON table.
methodology.validation: 50 rows; final expected published fields; 49 moves and 10-10 score, identical rows on reopen; quick_check; completed checkpoint count; empty ps_crud. Separately, one fresh run for each variant compared all 49 decoded moves against the service fixture and replayed Game to 10-10 and 20 boxes (see independentAll49Validation). The reusable final script now applies that strict validation to every run.
methodology.limitations: Fresh creation and reopen/read qualification only. No raw migration, post-reopen sync, account-switch, REMOVE, or fault injection qualification. No MicroPython, LittleFS, radio, device timing or power-loss claims. Native highwater excludes Python heap/shadow buffer; reserved 256 KiB arena and 128 KiB shadow stay fixed. Physical database counts instrument production _sync_db, not hardware flash programming. Host timings include macOS os.sync and cannot predict Tufty speedup.
methodology.repetitions: First three alternating-order repetitions retained from five completed exploratory repetitions. Later repetitions omitted; all sync barriers retained and os.sync unmodified.
